prediction_text: Yes — the match can be revived and will be effected. Though the Moon is void after separating from the gentleman's significator and applies to an opposition of the Sun (her present coldness and refusal), Jupiter in his exaltation applies to a sextile of Saturn, lord of the 7th, and transfers Saturn's virtue to the Sun, lord of the Ascendant, with no prohibition, abscission or frustration before the aspect perfects: a powerful third party / fortunate mediation joins them again. The gentleman should make the first move again about 19 June near noon; the business perfects about 27 June, when the aspect is completed (day-scale coordinate: 27 June). The lady must stoop to the renewal, but the marriage follows.
basis: 卡面未标注 tradition 字段，按题面体裁自决（Lilly horary，七宫婚姻章法）。systems_used: horary。已载面：婚事能否重续（主问）、不伤体面之虑（题面情境）。断项过闸：可续且成←木星擢升传光：六合七宫主土星并将其力转交升主太阳、无禁制截光；男方先动与成期←题面自载6月19日男方先动之议、6月27日相位成局，应期日档以成相日为主坐标。近段冷淡（月空亡、对冲太阳）与远段成婚分段写明，远段触发=木星传光成相。对象核：女方=升主太阳、男方=七宫主土星，逐名对回。
